facts.text: Under the Lakeland Promise, Wisconsin residents with an adjusted gross income of $80,000 or less receive full tuition and fees coverage for up to four years as incoming students or up to three years as transfer students.

sources.title: Traditional Undergraduate Financial Aid - Lakeland University
sources.quote: Lakeland Promise: Wisconsin residents with an AGI of $80,000 or less have tuition covered — the highest income threshold of its kind in the state.
